Leaving Early Access: 27 May, 2027

What the developers have to say:

Why Early Access?

“We want to bring the game into the hands of players during the development so that their feedback allows us to make the best drifting sim.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

“We’re planning to enter Early Access around Q2 2026 and a full launch scheduled for May 2027.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

“During Early Access we plan to release new locations, cars and expand our range of supported devices, also we’re planning to tweak balance based on players' feedback.

Please note that we will need to wipe players' profile at least once before leaving Early Access to ensure stability and fairness.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

“The game features the first iteration of single-player career mode, unlimited freeride solo and online on 6 maps, tandem drift training and ranked duels. You can buy and sell cars at car market, tune and customize every car.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

“The price might increase closer to the end of early access.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

“We’re planning on constantly gathering players' feedback through Steam discussions, our Discord server, and Facebook.”

Development

Roadmap

About This Game

A new entry in the CarX Drift Racing series features a real competition format and a judging system of modern drift championships.

Physics

The new realistic physics and tire model are a perfect fit for steering wheel setups and other game controllers. To prepare for multiplayer tournaments, you will progress from a beginner drift racer to a professional pilot, competing in world drift series.

Multiplayer

Duels, TOP 32 and freeride in online rooms. Skill-based matchmaking and a rating system in online events for your comfortable experience.

For us, drift is primarily a sport. To launch a series of esport tournaments around the world is the primary goal of this project.

Customization

An advanced tuning system and customization. Suspension, gearbox, ECU, and other important parts of a racecar are upgradeable, tunable, and finely customizable.

The damage system adds an extra layer of realism and immersion. Losing a bumper during a close call or leaving dents in a leader’s door is now possible!

Locations

The game features laser-scanned licenced tracks: Ebisu Circuit, Fuji Speedway & Gunma Cycle Sports Center in Japan, Nürburgring Nordschleife in Germany, Dominion Raceway in USA & ADM Raceway in Russia.

Career

You will start your drifting career in the drift school, learning the basics and mastering advanced drift control.

In Career mode, you’ll rise through the ranks - from local street contests to elite world championships. Compete in racing series, dominate championships, secure sponsorships, and fine-tune your cars to meet regulations. Most importantly, prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge - drifting online!

Controllers

We support most of steering wheels, gear shifters, gamepads, and other common controllers, available on the market, but we can always add more, the work’s not done yet.

System Requirements

    • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580 or similar at least 6 GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 14 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX® 9.0с
    • Additional Notes: SSD storage is highly recommended. The application’s stability is not guaranteed on Intel HD Graphics and AMD HD Radeon on-board graphics cards.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6700 or similar at least 8 GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 14 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX® 9.0с
    • Additional Notes: SSD storage is highly recommended. The application’s stability is not guaranteed on Intel HD Graphics and AMD HD Radeon on-board graphics cards. A racing wheel with FFB support is recommended.
